svg.title: three.rust — computation and persistent state ownership
svg.desc: The legacy bridge retains JS authority. The C2 facade retains evaluated matrices in Rust with JS inputs and hierarchy. The explicit owned rig API retains animation, transforms and palettes. Fine tiles map each declared scope, not complete public APIs.

g.text: Computation and authority: compatibility facade and owned rig pipeline
COMPATIBLE API — legacy JS state; opt-in C2 retains evaluated matrices in Rust
EXPLICIT OWNED API — commands → persistent Rust rig state + animation + transforms → final palettes
CPU functions: 5 scoped Rust mappings / 1515 tracked
One cell = one source definition or logical field mapping. Inspect each API scope; no complete public-method port is implied.
Counts describe the selected r186 source inventory; they are not speed, effort, or complete Three.js compatibility.
